about: Senior networking specialist with over a decade spent designing, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise networks. I like the discipline of network engineering: clear topologies, tight change windows, and monitoring that tells you about a problem before a user does.

experiences.description: Own the design and operation of a multi-site enterprise network, leading segmentation and resilience improvements. Coordinate maintenance windows and vendor work so that critical links stay redundant and observable.

Maintained core routing and switching for a regional service provider and resolved complex connectivity incidents. Rolled out improved monitoring that caught capacity issues well before they affected customers.

Administered campus networks and wireless infrastructure for a large organization, handling configuration and access control. Standardized device configurations to make troubleshooting faster and audits cleaner.
Supported branch-office connectivity and VPN access for distributed teams, responding to outages on call. Documented recurring failure patterns that informed later hardware refresh decisions.
Installed and configured switches and access points, and assisted senior engineers with cabling and labeling. Built the habit of meticulous documentation that I carried through the rest of my career.
Monitored network health from an operations center and escalated incidents according to defined procedures. Helped tune alert thresholds to cut down on noise without missing real problems.

projects.title: Connected Insights Platform for Supply Chain Research
projects.summary: Acted as product owner for an interactive analytics tool that visualized market and logistics data for research teams. Shaped the roadmap and prioritized features so that complex supply-chain signals were presented in a way decision-makers could explore directly.
